title: Weil compatibility of a normalized rational comparison
statement: For the data above, every normalized `RationalComparison` R satisfies the Frobenius tensor equation and has an isomorphism between its ordinary and completed Weil pairs, as in [lem-wf-tensor-completion-frobenius] and [lem-wf-tensor-pullback-completion-unit-square].

proof.text: Use the normalized localization equations and [lem-wf-tensor-pullback-completion-unit-square] to transport the integral unit square to arbitrary rational arrows; apply naturality to the two Weil structure maps and lift the resulting equations to IsoAlgebra morphisms.

lean.statement: theorem wfTensorCompletionFrobenius_weil_property (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (c : D.CoefficientDatum) (X₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [IsSeparated X₀.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields c.l c.Qbar) (R : WfTensorCompletion.RationalComparison D c X₀ E) (_hR : R.Normalized D c X₀ E) : ∀ K L : WeilD D c X₀ E, (R.ordinaryMu.app (K.carrier, L.carrier) ≪≫ R.ordinary.mapIso (K.str.prod L.str)).hom ≫ R.chi.hom.app (K.carrier, L.carrier) = ((weilFrobeniusPullback D c X₀ E).mapIso (R.chi.app (K.carrier, L.carrier)) ≪≫ R.completedMu.app (K.carrier, L.carrier) ≪≫ R.completed.mapIso (K.str.prod L.str)).hom ∧ ∃ e : R.ordinaryPair D c X₀ E K L ≅ R.completedPair D c X₀ E K L, e.hom.hom.f = R.chi.hom.app (K.carrier, L.carrier)
